context: Judges a new agent tool added to the Python shopping-assistant service, and the tests that come with it.

checklist.name: tool_added_and_registered
checklist.description: A new order-status tool function exists in shared/tools.py and is registered in the agent's tool list in src/agents/agents.py.

checklist.name: correct_endpoint
checklist.description: The tool calls GET /api/orders/{orderId}/status on the existing APPLICATION_ENDPOINT base URL.

checklist.name: explicit_timeout
checklist.description: The HTTP client is created with an explicit timeout, reusing the module's existing TIMEOUT.

checklist.name: errors_as_strings
checklist.description: On a non-success response (including 404) the tool returns a string containing the status code and response body instead of raising.

checklist.name: typed_and_documented
checklist.description: The tool function has type hints on every parameter and a docstring that documents each parameter.

checklist.name: test_success_case
checklist.description: An added test covers a successful status lookup and asserts on the tool's return value.

checklist.name: test_failure_case
checklist.description: An added test covers at least one failure (a 404, a timeout or a connection error) and asserts on the returned error string.

checklist.name: tests_isolated
checklist.description: The tests do not make real network calls; HTTP is mocked or stubbed.

checklist.name: tests_target_tool
checklist.description: The added tests import and call the new tool function itself, not a copy or a reimplementation of it.

checklist.name: minimal_change
checklist.description: Existing tools and unrelated files are not rewritten.
